evidence.quote: The EBSD map shown in figure 8-b reveals the twin orientation relationship between the matrix and defects, which develop on{111} planes. The point-to-point misorientation profile plotted along the white arrow of figure 8-b reveals the characteristic 60 ◦ rotation associated with twins in the FCC structure, shown in figure 8-c. Several EBSD maps were acquired in the different grains of the microstructure, leading to the conclusion that the observed defects are mostly deformation twins at 10% strain.
